kbuild.rust_config_prompt: Rust reference driver for Quality Semiconductor PHYs
rust_help: Uses the Rust reference driver for Quality Semiconductor PHYs (qsemi_rust.ko).
The features are intended to stay equivalent to the C driver.

phy_irq_callbacks.reason: Interrupt-capable PHY drivers need more than the current Rust PHY callback surface.
required_surface: A typed representation of interrupt enable state and handler return status.
A safe way to report PHY errors and trigger the PHY state machine from the abstraction layer.

phy_config_init.reason: The qsemi family needs a Rust callback surface for one-time PHY initialization.
required_surface: A safe `phy::Driver::config_init` hook in the PHY abstraction.

translation.goal: Constrain `qsemi` as a second-stage PHY case that is blocked on explicit interrupt-capable PHY abstraction work rather than ad-hoc driver invention.
translation.abstraction_goal: Make the missing IRQ/config-init PHY surfaces explicit before any `qsemi` Rust driver work starts.

mvp_scope.note: This module is intentionally blocked until the missing PHY IRQ callback surfaces are implemented and reflected in the artifacts.

body_plan: Write the vendor PCR initialization register through safe PHY register access only.
Model interrupt enable/disable through a typed PHY abstraction surface rather than raw `phydev->interrupts` inspection in the driver.
Return a typed interrupt outcome and keep `phy_error()` / `phy_trigger_machine()` inside the abstraction boundary.

private_state.note: The intended Rust qsemi driver should not require driver-owned private state for the first loop.
